entities.summary: Sir Peter Neville Luard Pears was an English tenor. His career was closely associated with the composer Benjamin Britten, his personal and professional partner for nearly forty years. Peter Pears was a composers & musicians from Farnham (1910-06-22, Farnham–1986-04-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
